description: Admin workspace 3-second loader, homepage 5-slide hero slider, dedicated magazine page with showcase, and MySQL compatibility fixes.
author: Conspodium Core Team
highlights: Added sleek 3-second animated light-theme loading screen on admin login and reload to give CMS data time to hydrate seamlessly
Enhanced homepage hero slider to exactly 5 slides with in-place CMS hydration and zero reload flicker
Restored dedicated Magazine page and homepage showcase section with order and subscription handling
Upgraded MySQL database engine compatibility with INT AUTO_INCREMENT DDL and zero-data-loss safeguards
Added automated installer fallback to import clean MySQL schema on shared hosting environments
